readerCopy.body: A small correction can trigger an outsized response when the standard is tangled with an old fear of being fundamentally inadequate. When Saturn squares Chiron, structure and sensitivity create friction, making one revision turn into an all-nighter or one missed detail sound like proof that far more is wrong. If one correction suddenly feels like a verdict on your competence, you may notice the emotional consequence has grown far beyond the practical mistake. Accountability works better when the repair remains proportional to what actually needs fixing.
